description: Bizuayeu's Jammed XSFP4 checkpoint (revision 0a22bb46) of Z.ai GLM-5.3-Flash, derived from NVIDIA GLM-5.3-Flash-FP4-Local: routed experts NVFP4 served W4A16 with a block scale every 32 inputs stored as one base and a 4-bit offset a row (csf0_v1), everything else FP4-Local's tensors as stored. Needs TensorFold's native engine (1.2.3 or later); vLLM and other NVFP4 loaders do not read the csf0_v1 form. Licence: NVIDIA Open Model Agreement (derivative of FP4-Local), commercially usable; upstream Z.ai model is MIT. Not gated.
